resources.string: For moving chat history with message branches, search history and available images. Use a SimpleChat backup for presets and non-image file contents.
Enter a character count between 4,000 and 1,000,000. The default is 16,000.
The complete user input for this turn is in message.txt. Read it and respond to the user request in the file.

Supports the DeepSeek Search / Fetch protocol. With the independent API enabled, web search retrieves results before generating an answer and reads links in your message. With the independent API disabled, you can still turn on web search in chat if your chat API supports built-in search (for example, the official DeepSeek API via its Anthropic-compatible endpoint). Check the sources. Search and Fetch may incur separate charges.

When enabled, the file picker uploads originals and references their file IDs. The image picker still uses local compression. Supports DeepSeek /files and compatible services. Files and chat must use the same service and account. For DeepSeek, use deepseek-flash. Files remain on the server and parsing may incur charges, even if you cancel waiting after upload.
Leave blank to follow the chat URL, or enter a DeepSeek or compatible service URL. Paths are appended to this URL. Reuse the chat key only with a trusted service that accepts it.
Leave blank to keep the saved key. Keys are encrypted at rest.
Document parsing (text, spreadsheets and ebooks use user_data)
Invalid URL or path. Use an HTTP(S) URL and a path starting with /, without credentials, query parameters or relative segments.
The tool API has no key. In Settings → API, enter a key under Independent Tool API or enable reuse of the chat key.
Enter a search result count between 1 and 50.
The tool API returned an unsupported response. Check its endpoint path and DeepSeek compatibility, or retry later.
The file exceeds %1$d MiB. Split or compress it and try again.
Unable to parse the file. Use a supported format, remove password protection, or convert it to PDF, DOCX or plain text.
The file is missing, expired or inaccessible to this account. Switch to its original service and account, or remove and upload the attachment again.
This attachment belongs to a different file service. Switch back, or remove it and upload it to the current service.
Check the model and protocol in Settings → API profiles, test the connection, then retry.
